invariants.rationale: The method immediately uses writeClient for method calls, so it is expected to be non-null.
instantTime is passed directly to client operations that likely expect a valid (non-empty) commit instant string.
The list of HoodieRecords is used as input and passed to upsertPreppedRecords, so it is likely required to be non-null.
If preppedRecordInputs is non-empty, it necessarily has positive size; checked for list sanity.
Prior to committing at this instantTime, it is likely that the instant has not yet been committed (if 'isCommitted(String)' exists in BaseHoodieWriteClient).
